## Problem and source

What problem does this change solve? Link the existing issue or requirement where one exists; new contributors do not need an internal Work identifier.

## Change and scope

What behavior, documentation, or interface changes? Which repositories or users are affected?

## Verification

What did you run or inspect, and what was the result? If checks could not run (including because of Actions capacity), say so. Distinguish code and document checks from deployment and actual consumer acceptance.

## Risk, security, and release

Call out compatibility, private data, credentials, untrusted CI inputs, release consequences, and rollback when applicable.

## Unfinished work

Identify missing review, tests, deployment, consumer receiving, or original obligations. Merging a PR does not itself settle the work.

For services that explicitly support an authenticated source handoff, follow their own [receiving procedure](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#qualified-source-handoff). Do not paste transport credentials or claim approval in the PR body.
